about: Skill-routing dev set, version 4. M skills: 2 positives (expects load) + 1 negative. U skills: 3 prose positives (expects recommend: the law says only a typed /ak:<id> starts one, so the reply recommends the command or loads and stops), 1 hard negative near the trigger (super-ship has a second: an ordinary commit on unreviewed work), and for five of them a positive that begins with the typed command (expects proceed). Every negative carries forbidden. dev-doc-review-p2 carries its document inline because the harness repository is empty. tests/learn/trigger-prompts.test.ts holds the split and the leakage guard.
